html:
Achieving academic goals in life requires a good amount of dedication and hard-work. Bearing this in mind, we at Arjunaa Academy have specially curated programmes that help students prepare for their academic future. These programmes are 2-Year Integrated Day Scholar Programme and 2-Year Integrated Residential Programme. The following article gives an overview about these programmes for you to get a better understanding.

 

2-Year Integrated Day Scholar Programme


This is an integrated programme that offers holistic education to students by infusing academics and extra-curricular activities. This kind of programme helps in the overall growth of a child. The main objective of this programme is to help students gain in-depth knowledge in PU/CBSE boards or CET, JEE, and NEET in a focused environment.

Benefits of this programme
 

  • 30 students/batch only
  • Highly trained faculty that include ex-IITians, NITians, and NEET toppers
  • Personal attention given to all students
  • Ample of self-study time
  • Board exam preparation and competitive exam preparation at the same time
  • Video solutions for every question
  • Mentoring process

2-Year Integrated Residential Programme


This course is ideally suited for students willing to fully focus on the study process to achieve their academic dreams. Our integrated residential programme puts students in a competitive, stimulating environment that helps them sharpen their skills and prepare fully for PUC/CBSE boards and competitive exams like JEE, NEET, KCET, and KVPY.

Benefits of this programme
 

  • Extensive coverage of syllabus for competitive exams and boards
  • Tests followed by test analysis sessions
  • Daily practice problems for home assignment
  • Test series to acquaint students with various exam patterns
  • Single comprehensive study material
  • Cumulative tests
  • Regular feedback for students
  • Career guidance sessions for students to choose the best undergraduate course



Arjunaa Academy has a proven track record of excellence in training students for their future goals. Our 2 years integrated day scholar and residential programmes are some of the best in Bengaluru for boards and competitive exam coaching. It is our mission not only to spread quality education to all, but also to nurture good morals and values in the leaders of tomorrow.
